steps.text: Open the detail of the meter to deactivate. The "Deactivate" button schedules the end of its activity on a given date.
steps.title: Meter detail

steps.text: Select the date from which the meter will no longer be active.
steps.title: Choose the end date

steps.text: Click "Deactivate": an inactive period is added to the meter from the chosen date.
steps.title: Confirm the deactivation

steps.text: Open the future-data tab: the scheduled deactivation shows there.
steps.title: Future data

steps.text: The "Future" tab shows the upcoming inactive period: the meter stays active until the chosen date, then is deactivated.
steps.title: Scheduled deactivation
